SAUDI ARABIA BECOMES INDIA'S SECOND-LARGEST CRUDE SUPPLIER IN OCTOBER

Saudi Arabia surpassed the UAE to become India's second-largest oil supplier in October. Russia retained its top spot as the leading crude supplier to India during the same period.
